Make and inspect voice calls

Usage:
  plivo voice calls [command]

Aliases:
  calls, call

Available Commands:
  diagnose    Diagnose what happened on a call (AI-powered, hits the voice debugger)
  dtmf        Send DTMF tones into a live call
  get         Get a call by UUID
  hangup      Hang up a live call (requires --yes)
  list        List calls
  make        Make an outbound call (requires --yes; spends money — use --dry-run to preview)
  play        Play audio file(s) into a live call
  record      Start recording a live call
  speak       Speak text into a live call via TTS
  stop-play   Stop any audio currently playing in a live call
  stop-record Stop the active recording on a live call
  stop-speak  Stop any TTS currently playing in a live call
  streams     Live audio streams on a call (WebSocket bridge for transcription / agents)
  transfer    Transfer one or both legs of a live call to new PlivoXML URLs

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for calls

Global Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo voice calls [command] --help" for more information about a command.
